name: vcu118
device_part_note: xcvu9p-flga2104-2L-e is the part on the standard VCU118 evaluation board and matches the existing P4_CMAC_QDMA Vivado projects on this machine, but it has NOT been confirmed against the board's own silkscreen/datasheet here. Confirm before building a bitstream.
notes: Added for the TCN feature-export work: the first target where --axi-data-width 512 and 100G line rate are the point. Pragma text is the same as zybo's (the compiler's Xilinx defaults), so RTL for this board differs from --board-unset only in the constraint skeleton. shift_reg_pragma keeps the per-stage forwarding chains as flip-flops rather than SRLs, same motivation as de2-115's altshift_taps case. NOT synthesis-verified: no VU9P synthesis has been run from this compiler, and timing_model.py's DEVICE_FACTOR['ultrascale-plus'] = 0.6 is still a public-doc estimate, so any Fmax or throughput claim for this board is unsupported until a real run replaces it. uram_style_pragma IS emitted since 2026-11-01, for a Register array of at least emit_processing.py's URAM_MIN_BITS (288Kb, one URAM block) and only under --register-ram, where the read is actually synchronous and the array is actually a RAM. Checked by scripts/check_uram.sh against verification/uram/uramprobe.p4, which carries one array either side of the threshold. Still not synthesis-verified: no VU9P run has confirmed Vivado honours it.
